title: Understanding Bernoulli Sampling
text: Bernoulli sampling involves selecting each row independently with a certain probability. This can lead to a sample that is not representative of the entire dataset.

title: Limit Clause in SQL
text: The LIMIT clause in SQL is used to specify the number of records to return. It can be used to extract a fixed number of rows from a table.

title: Comparing Sampling Methods
text: Consider how Bernoulli sampling and using a LIMIT clause might affect the representativeness of the sample. Which method is more likely to produce a biased sample?
